info.name: TravelBestie Manager API
info.description:
Complete test collection for the TravelBestie Manager REST API.

## Setup
1. Set `baseUrl` (default: `http://localhost:3000`)
2. Adjust `testUserEmail`, `testUserPassword`, `testUserName` if needed
3. **Optional — production only**: set `rsaPublicKeyBase64` (SPKI, base64, no PEM headers) to enable RSA-OAEP encryption for auth requests

## Dev vs production mode
**Dev (no `rsaPublicKeyBase64` set):** auth requests send plaintext body fields directly.
**Production (`rsaPublicKeyBase64` set):** pre-request scripts encrypt credentials with RSA-OAEP + SHA-256. Requires Postman v10+.

## OTP flow for Register
Register now requires an OTP. Run **Auth › Request OTP** first, check your email, set `testUserOtp`, then run Register.

## Run order
`token`, `tripId`, `shareId` are saved automatically. Run Auth → Trips → Shared Trips → Comments → Karma → Landing for the full happy path.
